quests.title: The Window Above Carramar
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. 28 years above Carramar. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since every second Friday the joins sound different. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Five in the morning at Homebush, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four. Ask for me by name at the counter.
